title: Vintage Los Angeles LA Lakers Lunch Bag Insulated 9”Cooler Purple NBA Elevation
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:Basketball-NBA
descriptionText:
This vintage Los Angeles Lakers lunch bag is the perfect accessory for any basketball fan. The insulated cooler is designed to keep your food and drinks cool while you cheer on your team. The purple color and Los Angeles Lakers team logo make it a stylish addition to any fan's collection.

The cooler is officially licensed by the National Basketball Association (NBA) and features no player's name. It is one size fits all and made specifically for basketball games. This product is a must-have for any fan who wants to show their support for the Los Angeles Lakers while keeping their food and drinks cool.
